'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Israel's role in the Syrian civil war]]
***The [[Israeli Air Force]] launches [[airstrike]]s near [[Damascus]], killing two [[civilian]]s, according to Syrian [[Syrian Arab News Agency|state media]]. The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] says that an "unknown number" of [[Iran]]-backed militants were also killed in the strikes, which targeted a [[counter-battery radar]] in [[As-Suwayda Governorate]], and a glass factory in [[al-Kiswah]], [[Rif Dimashq Governorate]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20230404-two-civilians-killed-in-israeli-air-strike-on-syria-s-damascus (France 24)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[United States Central Command]] says that [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] killed senior [[Islamic State]] leader Khalid 'Aydd Ahmad al-Jabouri, who was allegedly planning attacks in [[Europe]] during [[Easter]], in an overnight raid in rebel-held northwest [[Syria]]. The U.S. also says that there were no civilian casualties in the raid. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-military-operation-kills-islamic-state-leader-syria-officials-2023-04-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**Six [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] members are killed during a raid by the [[Taliban]] in [[Balkh Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/04/04/Taliban-raid-kills-six-ISIS-members-in-Afghanistan-s-Balkh-province (Al Arabiya)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Satellite]] launch service provider [[Virgin Orbit]] files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11 bankruptcy]] after failing to secure long-term funding. The [[California]]-based company announces that it will [[layoff]] 85% of its workforce. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/bransons-virgin-orbit-files-bankruptcy-2023-04-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Voorschoten train crash]]
**One person is killed and 50 others are injured, nineteen of them hospitalized, when a train [[derailment|derails]] in [[Voorschoten]], [[South Holland]], [[Netherlands]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65170980 (BBC News)]
*Seven people are killed and eleven others are injured in an [[avalanche]] in [[Nathu La]], [[Sikkim]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-avalanche-himalayas-tourists-killed-eb3ce612337614000499ec53ed23b1bd (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Finland–NATO relations]]
***[[Finland]] officially joins [[NATO]], becoming the 31st [[members of NATO|member]] of the [[military alliance]] and expanding NATO's border with [[Russia]] by {{convert|810|mi|order=flip}}. [https://time.com/6268323/finland-nato-countries-election-sweden (''Time'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65173043 (BBC News)]
*[[China–India relations]]
**[[Sino-Indian border dispute]]
***The [[Ministry of Civil Affairs|Ministry of Civil Affairs of China]] standardizes the names of 11 places in the [[Indian state]] of [[Arunachal Pradesh]] in a renewed attempt to assert Chinese territorial claim over the state. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/guwahati/beijing-releases-3rd-set-of-chinese-names-to-stake-claim-on-arunachal-pradesh/articleshow/99226038.cms?from=mdr (Times of India)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump]]
**[[Prosecution of Donald Trump in New York|Indictment of Donald Trump]]
***Former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] pleads not guilty to falsifying business records and to making a [[Stormy Daniels–Donald Trump scandal|hush money payment]] to [[Stormy Daniels]] at a [[Manhattan]] court. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/live-updates/trump-pleads-not-guilty-34-counts-indictment-arraignment-manhattan-court/ (CBS News)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/donald-trump-news-indictment-today-live-b2313810.html?amp (''The Independent'')]
***[[New York County District Attorney|Manhattan District Attorney]] [[Alvin Bragg]] formally announces the [[indictment]] of Trump. [https://bronx.com/manhattan-district-attorney-bragg-announces-34-count-felony-indictment-of-former-president-donald-j-trump/ (''Bronx Daily'')] 
*A court in the [[United Kingdom]] rules that the [[High Court of Justice]] has no jurisdiction over a lawsuit presented by a creditor against [[Cuba]] and [[Central Bank of Cuba|Cuba's Central Bank]] over unpaid loans from the 1980s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/cuba-wins-ruling-uk-court-battle-with-creditors-over-unpaid-loans-2023-04-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Peruvian political crisis (2017–present)|Peruvian political crisis]]
**[[Peruvian protests (2022–present)|Peruvian protests]]
***The [[Congress of Peru]] votes against the petition of [[impeachment]] of [[President of Peru|President]] [[Dina Boluarte]] over the alleged killings of protesters during the ongoing protests, amid a worsening volatility in the [[politics of Peru|country's politics]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-congress-rejects-request-start-impeachment-trial-president-2023-04-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Chicago mayoral election]]
**[[Brandon Johnson (politician)|Brandon Johnson]] wins a runoff election for [[mayor of Chicago]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/04/04/chicago-mayors-race-results-00090504 (Politico)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Information Commissioner's Office]] (ICO) fines [[TikTok]] £12.7m for "failing to protect the privacy of children" on the [[online video platform]]. It is one of the largest fines ever issued by the ICO. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-65175902 (BBC News)]
